description: This PHP file defines the InterviewAttachmentsController class, which manages the attachment view and permission checks for interviews in the recruitment module of the HRM system. It handles pre-rendering setup and access control for interview attachments.

classes.name: InterviewAttachmentsController
classes.description: Controller for managing interview attachments, including rendering the attachments view and checking user permissions.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the view component with interview ID, maximum file size, and allowed file types for attachments. Throws exception if interview record not found.

methods.name: isCapable
methods.description: Checks if the current user has access to the interview identified by interview ID.
